title: [Chapitre] VI. Analysis situs (deuxième mouture) : notes manuscrites (18-20/06/1986).

errors: No mathematical error is visible. (1.59) is consistent provided ≭ is reflexive on lieux, which is implicit.
The exact meaning of ≭ versus ⋔ (previous page) is not fixed on this page. The ≭ of At 9'' seems to play the role of ⋔ in At 9', so there may be notational drift between pages.
At 9'' as an 'iff' is strong: the ⇒ direction (X ≭ Y forces F empty or elementary) is a genuine axiom, not a consequence, and is exactly what fails for non-regular cell structures.

ideas.what: Reducing the incidence-type relation on all multiplicities to its restriction to lieux (points) in the 'ensembliste' case, with ∥ and ≭ on points interdefinable (1.59)
ideas.modern_name: Determination of a regular cell complex / face poset by vertex data; abstract simplicial or polyhedral complexes
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical combinatorial topology (abstract simplicial complexes; face posets of regular CW complexes, Björner 1984)
ideas.where_published: Unpublished 1986 Analysis situs notes; the tame-topology programme is sketched in Esquisse d'un programme (1984)

ideas.what: Observation that the most important examples are non-ensembliste, so the point-based description fails and weaker axioms are needed
ideas.modern_name: Non-regular CW / stratified complexes where cells are not determined by their vertex sets
ideas.where_published: Possibly echoed in Esquisse's critique of set-theoretic topology; unsure

ideas.what: Axiom At 9'': X ≭ Y iff shadows outside the intersection are pairwise ∥ and X ∩ Y is empty or a common multiplicity
ideas.modern_name: Intersection-is-a-face axiom for polyhedral/regular cell complexes, combined with a vertex-wise separation criterion
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard in definitions of polyhedral complexes and regular CW complexes

missed.claim: Grothendieck's axiom system for 'Atlas' (multiplicités with ≤, ≪, an incidence relation, shadows omb, lieux) is a home-made axiomatics of combinatorial stratified spaces that was never published or developed. This page is one small step: a 'simplified' replacement for At 9' adapted to non-set-theoretic cases. As a self-contained result it is minor.
missed.quote: le seul hic, c'est qu'il n'est pas satisfait dans les cas intéressants les plus importants ... on peut se rabattre sur une propriété qui fera le même usage
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Of mainly historical interest. The whole axiomatics, rather than this page, could be compared with modern combinatorial models of stratified spaces (exit-path posets, regular cell complexes, o-minimal cell decompositions).

deep.surprise_reason: This is a technical step in an unpublished axiomatics. The content (intersection of two cells is a face or empty; point-level description in the set-theoretic case) is standard combinatorial topology. The only interest is as a record of Grothendieck's 1986 tame-topology programme.
transcription_corrections: Page number at top is likely '63', not '13'.
'pour deux lignes[?]' is more likely 'pour deux lieux' (underlined), consistent with L = set of lieux.
'le seul lien' should read 'le seul hic'.
'qui fera le = usage' means 'qui fera le même usage'.
'Af 9''' / 'Af 9'' should read 'At 9''' / 'At 9'' (Atlas axioms), as on adjacent pages.
'Af-ensemble[?] 1' is probably 'F comme en At 9'' (F = X ∩ Y).
'conv b X', 'conv b F' should read 'omb X − omb F' and 'omb Y − omb F' (shadows minus shadow of F).
'F est {ni vide ni tout} élémentaire' is more likely 'F est (vide ou est) "élémentaire" (i.e. F ∈ M, i.e. c'est une multiplicité commune)'.
'lorsqu'on [?] dans des cas non "ensemblistes"' is probably 'lorsqu'on est dans des cas "ensemblistes"' (the point is that it works in set-theoretic cases).
